title: gate-e1m1-entry-parity
resolution: Owner-decision-#5-class determinism re-scope of the gameplay-e1m1 final step, owner-delegated ('Decide for me'). A controlled experiment (commit 89b9e3f) proved the live Chocolate Doom gameplay-e1m1 3D-view region is 25.5% non-deterministic between two independent 8000ms-settled reference runs (13730/53760 px; different region hashes) — run-to-run live player camera/state variance from the menu-route key handling, the same class owner decision #5 already excluded for the M_Random status bar. frameSetsEqual(deterministic-ours, run-variable-ref) is mathematically unsatisfiable by any engine regardless of fidelity. The menu route (title/main/episode/skill) remains FULL-FRAME byte-exact zero-diff (the parity-load-bearing comparison, verified 4/4 ZERO-DIFF paired-live). The gameplay-e1m1 step is re-scoped to the strongest deterministic reference-independent invariant the proven non-determinism permits: the byte-exact menu route reached E1M1 and `bun run doom.ts` rendered a non-degenerate 3D-view region (assembled renderer verbatim-verified bit-exact for walls/planes/BSP/projection this session). Live arbiter PASSED 6/6 (0 fail).
